profile.headline: Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: Sr. Java / JavaScript Developer / AWS Expert

positions.title: Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer
positions.description: AWS Certified Pro, Microservices in Java/spring, c#/.net core. SPA using Angular, Nodejs.

positions.title: Sr. Java Developer
positions.description: Working on the Health Management Platform (HMP) project.  Creating the platform for browser-based, clinical user-interface modules.  The core technologies include: Java 7, Spring (MVC, Security, Messaging, JMX, Templates, Conversion service), Jackson JSON Processor, HTML5, JavaScripts(  ExtJS, jQuery, bootstrap), JSON, AJAX, SASS, CI (Jenkins, Nexus, Git, Maven/Gradle), REST, InterSystem Cache NoSQL database

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on the project building a medical vocabulary server (as part of Clinical Information System Platform) through the entire project life cycle from inception through implementation and support.  	Experiences with HLI, 3M HDD, and LexEVS.  The core technologies included: Java 6, OSGi, Spring, Virgo Tomcat Server, Maven, eclipse, Oracle, Google Protocol Buffer

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer
positions.description:
ATK is all about Rocket Science!  The company manufactured/provided Reusable Solid Rocket Motor (RSRM) for the NASA Space Shuttle program.  

Worked for the manufacturing solutions team developing Electronic Shop Instruction (ESI) systems , which is the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for Rockets.  The ESI systems were used to author and edit electronic plans (rocket scientists), release shop orders, and perform works on the shop floor (engineers and technicians).  
	
Worked on the developments of EJB components, Swing thick clients, and JSF-based web application. (J2EE, IBM Rational Application Development (RAD) , WebSphere Application Server, Tomcat, EJB, JSF, Web Service, Servlet, JSP, Hibernate, JPA, 	Swing for the application client, SOA, Oracle database, UGS document management system)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the developments of CRM (targeted for the financial sector) and PowerStation Web Application (the front office solutions for the Phase3 back office) using Eclipse, Sevlet, JSP, JavaScript, Struts, JSTL and custom tags, Tomcat, MySQL, JDBC/Torque for database connectivity.

Worked on Back Office Normalization project: to normalize the various data sources of the back offices including ADP, Global Plus, Phase 3 and etc into the common database so that the clients can use the SunGard front-end applications to see the back office data.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Distributed Computing Infrastructure using C++ / MFC for Telecommunication companies called ViPrNET using TAO CORBA implementation.

Developed Voice Portal Application running on ViPrNET: Designed and implemented call flows for browsing Internet using Voice and Telephone in ViPrNET environment.  

Wrote MIBs and Developed cross-platform SNMP Agents: Used snmp++ and agent++ libraries.  

Designed and Implemented Database Synchronization tools using MFC
